message:
fix(mcp): propagate async tool cancellation

Propagate caller cancellation from executeToolAsync to the underlying MCP request. Preserve transport-specific cancellation notification semantics and existing timeout handling.

Validation: 269 langchain4j-mcp unit tests passed with 3 skipped; focused cancellation tests passed; Spotless check and git diff --check passed.

Simplify cancellation propagation and cover server-side cancellation

Cancelling the handled future already fires its own completion callback, so relaying it into a second future is unnecessary. Also covers that a server-side cancellation of an async tool call surfaces as CancellationException, as it does for the blocking executeTool().

fix(mcp): notify listeners on async cancellation

Report source and caller cancellations through onExecuteToolError without
wrapping CancellationException. Claim terminal processing atomically to
prevent duplicate callbacks when cancellation races with a response.

Extend the cancellation regressions with listener context and exactly-once
assertions, including caller cancellation from a server cancellation
callback. Apply Spotless to the existing chained assertion.

Validation: focused cancellation tests 4/4; DefaultMcpClientTest 77/77;
MCP unit suite 271 tests, 3 skipped, 0 failures/errors; Spotless apply/check
and git diff --check passed.
